metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Iris Creakword
records.biography_en: In Interpreters for the Untranslatable, Iris Creakword takes the role of door-creak interpreter. “That was a very reluctant hello.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small old brass hinge attached to a short handheld wooden block.

records.name: Wes Longpause
records.biography_en: In Interpreters for the Untranslatable, Wes Longpause takes the role of recorder of meaningful pauses. “The pause lasted three pages.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small blank notebook and one pocket hourglass with clear glass.

records.name: Gus Shrugfile
records.biography_en: In Interpreters for the Untranslatable, Gus Shrugfile takes the role of archivist of shrugs. “One shrug. Three folders.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: stack of three chunky little unlettered binders held close below face.

records.name: Perry Sighmeter
records.biography_en: In Interpreters for the Untranslatable, Perry Sighmeter takes the role of translator of sighs. “That one had a footnote.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small soft air bulb with a round simple dial, held at flank.

records.name: Tess Teaclang
records.biography_en: In Interpreters for the Untranslatable, Tess Teaclang takes the role of interpreter of porcelain sounds. “The spoon disagrees.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small saucer and a spoon held near the ear lobe.

records.name: Ned Eyebrow
records.biography_en: In Interpreters for the Untranslatable, Ned Eyebrow takes the role of subtitler of raised eyebrows. “I would leave that untranslated.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one blank speech-shaped clay token and a tiny pencil.
